preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The input string s contains only digits.
The first character of the string s is not '0', as '0' does not have a letter mapping.

postconditions.description: The function returns a non-negative integer representing the total number of ways to decode the input string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 or all(int(s[i-1:i]) in range(1, 27) for i in range(1, len(s)))
postconditions.description: Each substring of two digits in the input string s represents a valid letter mapping from 'A' to 'Z' if it is within the range 1 to 26.
